name: Kago no Naka no Alicis
source:
Long time ago there was a peaceful and prosperous land. The central tree there supplied life to the world. One day, the tree began to wither. The people of the world began fighting, but one girl came up to the tree and began crying in front of it. Her tears were filled with love and they began to rejuvenate the withered tree. With her love, the tree flourished and all was right with the world. She became known as ‘Alicis’ and was locked into a cage. One day, Alicis fell in love with a man. The tree began to wither because Alicis had given all her love to the man instead of the tree. The two decided to escape the cage and go to a different world. Once they entered that world, a bright light shone and the girl died. The man despaired and hated all light from that moment on. His hatred covered the world and brought darkness to a world that never knew anything other than light.

The heroine, Sumeragi Runa, once again sees the tree in her dream. It’s her quiet place where she can just relax, but all the sudden the tree begins to wither. She attempts to save it, but before she actually does anything she wakes up. On the way to school, she hears a voice and is suddenly transported to a different world by M and L, the guardians of that world (Luche).  Before she hounds them for answers, a guy with red hair appears and whisks her away at the guardians request.

While walking, he introduces himself as Harvey and asks that she not tack on a ‘-san’ at the end of his name. He’s happy that she seems like a good kid though she’s kind of tainted with noir. He brings her to a castle called Sefira and introduces her to the rest of the Roacrysto. 

[Taken from a [url=http://spadey.wordpress.com/2011/03/18/kagononakanoalicis-trial-impressions/]preview[/url] blogpost by Spadey]
translation:
很久以前，有一片和平富饶的土地。那里中央的巨树为世界供给生命。某天，巨树开始枯萎，世间众人也开始彼此争斗。一名少女来到树前哭泣，她的泪水饱含爱意，使枯萎的巨树重新焕发生机。在她的爱滋养下，巨树枝繁叶茂，世界也恢复了安宁。人们称她为“阿莉西丝”，并将她关进笼中。某天，阿莉西丝爱上了一名男子。由于她把全部的爱都给予男子，而不是巨树，树木再度开始枯萎。二人决定逃出牢笼，前往另一个世界。进入那个世界后，一道强光闪过，少女死去了。男子陷入绝望，从此憎恨一切光明。他的憎恨笼罩世界，为一个此前只知光明的世界带来了黑暗。

女主角皇琉奈再一次在梦中看见那棵树。这里是她能够静心休息的地方，巨树却突然开始枯萎。她试图拯救它，可还没来得及行动便醒了过来。上学途中，她听见一个声音，随后被那个世界“露切”的守护者M和L传送到异世界。她还没来得及逼问二人，一名红发男子便应守护者的请求突然出现，将她带走。

行进途中，男子自称哈维，并请她不要在自己的名字后加上“先生”。他很高兴她看上去是个好孩子，尽管身上似乎沾染了一点黑暗。他把琉奈带到一座名为塞菲拉的城堡，并将她介绍给罗亚克里斯托的其他成员。

[摘自Spadey的一篇[url=http://spadey.wordpress.com/2011/03/18/kagononakanoalicis-trial-impressions/]试玩感想[/url]]
